annotations.title: Audit Substack Newsletters, Paid ARR, Sponsors, RAG Posts & Notes

description:
Audit Substack newsletters across 35 categories, search queries, or handles/URLs to compute Stripe USD paid ARR floors, detect sponsor brands and media kits, verify author emails (MX/DMARC), stream RAG post archives, and extract Notes and comments.

Parameters: Supply categories, searchQueries, publicationUrlsOrHandles, or upstreamItems (omitting all returns 0 items at $0). Choose mode ("newsletter_intelligence", "post_sponsor_stream", or "notes_and_comments"), optional watchDiff + dedupStoreName, or pre-charge filters. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Runs in 128 MB pure HTTP ($0 proxy), writes optional watchDiff KV snapshots and webhookUrl payloads, isolates unreachable hosts in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $4/1K newsletters, $0.40/1K posts, or $0.25/1K notes/comments ($0 on empty/unchanged/filtered misses).

Use for Substack sponsor leads, revenue intel, RAG archives, and Notes/comments; do not use for Link-in-Bio agencies (use enrich_creator_bio_leads) or Shopify Apps (use audit_shopify_app_churn_leads).

categories.description: Optional Substack category slugs or names (e.g. ["technology", "finance", "business", "culture"]). Optional when searchQueries or publicationUrlsOrHandles is provided.

crmPreset.description: Optional flat OWASP CSV-safe CRM export preset.

dedupStoreName.description: Optional Apify Named Key-Value Store name for watchDiff snapshots (default: substack-intel-watch).

discoveryBoard.description: Substack category board to pull: paid (bestsellers), trending (rising), public_all (free + paid), or both_leaderboards.

excludeDormant.description: Pre-charge filter: skip dormant newsletters with no post in 45+ days at $0.

includeAboutAndDomainEnrich.description: Fetch /about, author public_profile, and 1-hop custom domain /sponsor or /contact pages for emails, media kits, and DNS MX/SPF/DMARC checks.

includeCleanPostText.description: In post_sponsor_stream mode, fetch full public post bodies and output paragraph-preserving cleanPlainText + ragTokenEstimate.

maxCommentsPerPost.description: In notes_and_comments mode, maximum flattened nested reader comments per post (0-200).

maxNotesPerAuthor.description: In notes_and_comments mode, maximum public Substack Notes per author (0-200).

maxPostsPerPublication.description: Maximum recent posts per publication via streaming RSS or /api/v1/archive cursor pagination (1-500).

minBestsellerTier.description: Pre-charge filter: minimum Substack bestseller paid-subscriber badge tier (0, 100, 1000, 10000; $0 below).

mode.description: Execution mode: newsletter_intelligence ($4/1K dossiers), post_sponsor_stream ($0.40/1K RAG posts + sponsors), or notes_and_comments ($0.25/1K public Notes + nested comments).

onlyWithEmail.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only newsletters with at least one verified email ($0 otherwise).

onlyWithSponsorSignal.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only newsletters with detected sponsor blocks, banners, or media-kit links ($0 otherwise).

outreachPersona.description: Outreach persona used to tailor outreachSubject and outreachBody.

publicationUrlsOrHandles.description: Optional direct Substack URLs, custom newsletter domains, subdomains, or @author handles (e.g. ["https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com", "bytebytego", "@semianalysis"]).

searchQueries.description: Optional Substack search keywords to discover niche newsletters (e.g. ["semiconductors", "ai engineering"]).

upstreamItems.description: Optional upstream JSON rows from Clay, Make, n8n, or another Apify Actor for cross-run chaining under LIMITED_PERMISSIONS.

watchDiff.description: Enable weekly stateful watch_diff in newsletter_intelligence mode to skip unchanged publications at $0 and emit 8 change triggers.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive run results.

name: audit_substack_newsletters_leads

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Substack newsletter intelligence dossiers, RAG post archive rows, or public Notes & nested comment records.

bestsellerTier.description: Verified Substack paid bestseller tier (100, 1000, 10000, etc.).

bodyText.description: Plain text content of a Substack Note or nested reader comment (in notes_and_comments mode).

cleanPlainText.description: Paragraph-preserving plain text for AI/RAG pipelines (in post_sponsor_stream mode).

hasSponsorSignal.description: Whether sponsor blocks, banner ads, or media-kit links were detected.

primaryEmail.description: Prioritized author or sponsor contact email (or null).

publicationUrl.description: Canonical newsletter URL (custom domain or substack.com).

recordType.description: Record type: substack_newsletter_intelligence, substack_post, substack_note, or post_comment.

totalSubscribersApprox.description: Approximate total subscriber count parsed from Substack metadata.

verifiedPaidArrFloorUsd.description: Conservative USD annual paid revenue floor derived from bestsellerTier and Stripe plans.
